aboutTagline: Cashier & Daily Recap App for Small Businesses
aboutPhilosophyBody1: Catat Untung was created specifically for shop owners, food businesses, coffee shops, and Indonesian small businesses that need a practical, fast bookkeeping solution with no monthly subscription fee.
aboutPhilosophyBody2: We believe every trader deserves to know their business net profit clearly and transparently, without the hassle of manual calculator math every night.
aboutPillar1Description: 100% of your business data stays exclusively on your device. No data is uploaded to external servers, keeping your business privacy safe.
aboutPillar2Description: A modern, Gojek-style interface that is light and intuitive lets you record sales in just 30 seconds.
aboutPillar3Title: Accurate Cost of Goods & Profit Calculation
aboutPillar3Description: An automatic formula that separates gross revenue, material cost, packaging, down to the net profit you can set aside.
aboutDevMotto: Made with dedication to support millions of entrepreneurs and small businesses across the archipelago.
aboutCopySuccess: App info & copyright copied to clipboard
aboutDonationBody: Catat Untung is 100% free, no data quota required, and has no subscription fee. If this app helps your business operations, show your appreciation by treating the developer to a coffee via QRIS.
aboutQrisInstructions: Scan the QRIS code below with any e-wallet or mobile banking app (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, Dana, etc.).
